positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY: reproduce EXACTLY the same number of people as appear in the provided photo. Not one more, not one fewer. If the photo shows one person, the output must show that one person completely alone. If it shows nine, exactly those nine. Never invent, add, duplicate, or imagine any additional person. The development kitchen behind and beside them is completely empty of other people — no other staff, no bystanders, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: ignore the clothing worn in the provided photo and dress everyone in a crisp white food R&D lab coat over a light collared shirt, with an ID badge clipped at the chest. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain white to match, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them. No hairnet, no mask, no goggles.

BRAND MARK: one of the provided reference images is the Garudafood corporate logo — a blue eagle head facing right with a gold beak and a blue leaf sprig below it, beside the bold blue "Garudafood" wordmark. Reproduce it accurately, keeping the blue and gold colours and the eagle shape intact. It appears small and neat on the left chest of every lab coat, roughly palm-sized, and once more as a clean sign on the wall of the kitchen behind.

PRODUCTS: the other provided reference image shows the Garudafood product range — foil packs of coated and roasted peanuts, boxed chocolate wafer sticks, sandwich biscuit packs, bags of corn and potato crisps, chocolate bars and cartons of chocolate drink, in bright blue, red, orange, green, gold and cream packaging. Use these exact packs where the scene calls for products; do not invent other brands.

SCENE: standing in a bright modern snack and beverage product development kitchen. Around them: trays of prototype snack products, small white tasting bowls, flavour and seasoning ingredient jars, Garudafood mock-up packaging pinned to a concept board, and stainless-steel test kitchen equipment. The person nearest the camera holds a small tasting bowl of snack samples at chest height. Clean, appetising, professional food-lab environment.

FRAMING: photographed by a photographer standing in front of the group at natural standing eye level, straight-on, horizon level. Not a selfie, no arm reaching toward the lens, no wide-angle distortion. Waist-up to mid-thigh crop — legs, knees, feet and shoes are not visible. Everyone stands in a natural staggered arrangement with subtle depth — bodies angled at a relaxed three-quarter turn of about 20 degrees, faces turned directly to the lens. Not a stiff straight row. Nobody hidden, every face sharp and individually recognisable.

LIGHTING: bright airy high-key light with a large soft key from window-left, a clean white bounce filling the shadow side, and a crisp rim light along shoulders and hair separating everyone from the pale kitchen behind. Highlights glinting off the stainless steel. Fresh, clean, appetising.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 40mm, f/2.0. Everyone tack sharp with a clear depth separation — the environment behind rendering into soft creamy bokeh, background practical lights blooming into gentle round highlights. Subtle atmospheric haze in the air catching the light, giving the room real depth. Fine natural film grain, slight highlight roll-off, gentle anamorphic-style falloff at the frame edges. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural shine and subtle imperfections, no plastic smoothing.

GRADE: rich cinematic colour grading with deep controlled contrast — lifted filmic blacks, warm highlights, clean natural skin tones held perfectly neutral against the environment's colour. Premium FMCG brand campaign quality, the polish of a national television commercial. High resolution.

DO NOT: add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes or a full-body view; render any readable text, slogan, label, price tag or signage wording other than the Garudafood wordmark itself; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: Slow cinematic push-in. The subjects breathe naturally with gentle eye blinks. The person holding the sample tasting bowl subtly tilts it slightly toward the camera to showcase the snack prototypes, then looks up at the lens with an approving, confident smile and a subtle nod. Soft ambient kitchen light glints on the stainless steel, warm professional food-lab atmosphere, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
video_negative_prompt: distorted face, face morphing, extra limbs, chaotic camera movement, glitch, blurry, deformed hands, mouth talking unnaturally, bad anatomy, cartoon, plastic skin, dull flat lighting
